newsitem.title: INDIA: Cyclone strikes India's east coast, kills 20.
newsitem.headline: Cyclone strikes India's east coast, kills 20.

text.p: A cyclone struck India's east coast near the port of Kakinada late on Wednesday, killing at least 20 people, the Press Trust of India news agency reported on Thursday.
It quoted unnamed sources as saying the death toll could be more than 100 in the agriculturally rich area of Konaseema in the southern state of Andra Pradesh, which bore the brunt of the storm.
Twelve fishing boats and their 60 occupants were also reported missing, PTI said.
Transport and communications in the area were disrupted, it said.
The coastal area where the cyclone hit is India's prime rice growing area, further inland cotton is grown and oilseeds are also cultivated in the region.
